instruction: Make replacement authorization and lineage one atomic journal transition, or persist a pending replacement constraint that start must consume only for the exact failed operation key. Reject arbitrary replacement metadata on generic starts, add negative and concurrency/interleaving coverage, and provide frozen command-level check evidence; retain the real provider episode as a required post-integration proof if it cannot validly run before integration.

findings.summary: Replacement authorization and lineage are not enforced atomically by the supervisor journal state machine.
Frozen verification evidence does not substantiate the declared checks or the required real replacement episode.
